item.title: BCCI Announces Massive INR 131 Crore Cash Reward for Team India After ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 Triumph
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced a significant financial reward of Rs 131 crore for the Indian men’s cricket team following their triumph in the T20 World Cup. The announcement, made on Tuesday, follows India’s clinical performance in the tournament final, securing the nation’s latest ICC trophy.

item.title: Business News | IDFC FIRST Bank Completes Reconciliation of All Relevant Accounts in Chandigarh Branch Claims; Paid Net Principal Amount of Rs 645 Crore
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. The final payout is Rs 55 crore higher than the initial principal estimate of Rs 590 crore previously disclosed to stock exchanges.

item.title: Are the Bill Clinton and Stephen Hawking ‘Princess Dress’ Epstein Photos Real? Fact-Checking Viral AI Images
item.description: Viral images showing Stephen Hawking in a princess dress and Bill Clinton in compromising attire are confirmed AI-generated fakes. Despite social media claims, these photos do not exist in the unsealed Jeffrey Epstein court documents. While both men are mentioned in the files, the records contain no such photographic evidence or descriptions.
